item.title: 002 — God is for the poor.
item.description: A long-form story about faith as hope under financial insecurity, religious belonging as a language of public trust, and the responsibility that follows. Includes two sourced survey graphs, conceptual illustrations, and examples of faith organizing practical care and demands for rights.

item.title: 001 — The machines were never the whole story.
item.description: From Smith’s pin factory to AI: a visual exploration of automation, economics, and who gets the gains. Includes historical perspectives, charts, an interactive productivity experiment, and sourced explorations of Newton, cognitive offloading, meaningful work, and the freedom to pursue new questions. Includes a companion video with James Suzman.
